modalLead: Widgets can now sit in Tabs, show a clock or count down to a date, and every theme has a backdrop of its own: 266 in all, behind the new default theme Aurora Glass. Search answers sums, and Config shows what you changed and keeps earlier layouts of a page.

items.text: Tabs, Clock and Countdown. A Tabs widget puts several widgets of one page in one tile, a Clock shows the time in any time zone, and a Countdown counts the days to a date. Add them from Add a widget.
items.title: Tabs, clocks and countdowns

media.alt: A Tabs tile with the tabs Health, Weather and Notes on a dashboard page

items.text: Duplicate and Refresh now. Right-click a widget to duplicate it with its settings; media, Beszel, Home Assistant and Custom widgets also have Refresh now.
Show a widget only on set times and days, and amber and red limits for the disk and memory widgets.
Search answers sums. Type 15% of 240, 2+2*3 or 5 km in mi and the answer is the top row; Enter copies it. Nothing leaves your browser.
items.title: Search answers sums

media.alt: The search panel with 15% of 240 answered as 36 in the top row

items.text: A backdrop for every theme. The themes have a new look: each of the 192 theme families has a backdrop of its own in its colours. The picker starts short, with this theme's backdrop, ones like it and those you used lately. Try it!
items.title: A backdrop for every theme

media.alt: The backdrop picker with This theme, Like it and All backdrops (266)

items.text: Aurora Glass is the default theme on new installs. A new install also shows the online/offline status on its rows; installs that already exist keep their settings.
Tag colours. Give a tag a colour in Config → Bookmarks → Tags; it shows in the tag cloud and on the rows.
See what you changed. The Overview lists every setting that differs from its default, with a Copy as text button.
Layout history. nextDash keeps earlier layouts of each page; open the history, see what a restore would change, and restore it.
Import a Homepage, Dashy or Homer configuration from Data and backups.
A clearer weekly digest, with charts, and the watched feed figures in the statistics CSV.
The backdrop groups are in English, and the Config page no longer moves while a setting is saved.
